source: Generated by an image-generation subagent using the user-supplied convenience-store mockup as a planting-density reference.
prompt_summary: Create a long alpha-transparent grouped garden border for an isometric Japanese convenience-store game. Use upright medium/tall trees, dense stepped green shrubs, restrained pink/white flowers and a continuous soil/ground-contact base near the bottom. Illustrated game-art rendering to complement the simplified store. No checkerboard, chroma key, glow, backdrop, road, building, text or signs.
integration: Runtime candidate replacing the previous perimeter panorama. Baseline (100,700)-(2070,700) maps to world z=0 at 2.43m beyond the wall, using uniform edge-specific 12m, 18m and 20m scales. Wall/paving layers hide the root edge.
